_comment: Weekly gameweek sequence, following runbook.md section B.
Commands run from {ROOT} with argv split by shlex — no shell, so no pipes.
declared in that step's 'params'. {ARCHIVE} resolves at launch to the
A blank optional param removes its own token and the flag before it.
'clean' lists directories cleared before the step runs — stale files from
a larger previous run would otherwise be picked up by the next glob.
'enabled: false' keeps a step visible but skips it during Run all.

steps.name: Archive, validate, EV solve
steps.blurb: One command: snapshots ownership, prices and fixtures, gates on validation, runs the stock solver, commits. If validation fails, read validation.log and fix the data rather than forcing past it.

steps.name: Deep source validation
steps.blurb: Optional and cheap. Adds the API availability cross-check on top of what the archive step already gated on. Needs mixed.csv, which only exists once the archive step's solve has run — hence its position here.
steps.command: uv run python validate_sources.py --sources solio review --mixed mixed.csv --bootstrap {ARCHIVE}/bootstrap_slim.json

steps.name: Enrich from Solio
steps.blurb: Pulls published team clean-sheet odds and per-player DefCon probabilities from the free 4-hourly endpoint. If the fetch fails it refuses to write and the generator simply runs unenriched.

steps.name: Generate scenarios
steps.blurb: Outcome sampling with team-level correlation. Check the printed calibration line — bias should land within ±0.05.
steps.command: uv run python scenario_generator.py --sources review solio --data-dir {DATA} --scenarios {scenarios} --out scenarios/ --horizon {horizon} --enrich {DATA}/enrich.json

steps.name: Stochastic transfer decision
steps.blurb: The committed stage-1 move plus the recourse branches — what you'd likely do next week in each world. Gap is 0.01 here by design: the two-stage problem won't close to zero in reasonable time.

steps.name: Stochastic — preseason squad
steps.blurb: Builds the initial 15 under uncertainty instead of taking a transfer decision. Use for GW1 and wildcards, where --squad does not apply. --vss prices what planning under uncertainty bought over solving on the mean; near zero is a real finding, not a failure.

steps.name: Score a squad's tail
steps.blurb: Run this when B2 and B4 disagree — score each candidate squad in turn. Agreement between the two solvers means you can skip it entirely.

steps.name: CVaR alternative squad
steps.blurb: Builds a tail-safe squad against the effective-ownership field and compares it with the EV pick.

steps.name: Enumerate chip plans
steps.blurb: One full solve per chip-timing combination — minutes each, so start narrow. Consensus plans go in as candidates and are scored on identical footing with solver-found timings. Clears plans/ first: logs from an earlier projection vintage are not comparable with fresh ones.

steps.name: Score chip plans
steps.blurb: Scores every plan in plans/ across the scenario set: win share, regret, and a verdict line when the top two sit inside the noise band. Advisory only — it does not feed the solves above.
steps.command: uv run python chip_planner.py score --plans plans/ --scenario-dir scenarios/ --bootstrap {ARCHIVE}/bootstrap_slim.json
